text:
[IRET.7.9.2] **On right-activation (new fact in alpha):**
- For each token in left memory: re-evaluate join tests
  with this new fact.
- For each token that now matches: increment its block
  count. If block count was 0 before: retract the
  downstream token (the absence no longer holds).

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate
idris.note: On right-activation a NOT node counts the fact against each left token it joins and retracts downstream the tokens whose count was zero before.

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__block
idris.note: A new blocking fact: every left token it joins gains a blocker.

idris.name: Iret_7_9_2__rejects
idris.note: The clause's retraction of the downstream token, read as its effect: no activation remains whose NOT node the new fact satisfies.

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__acquire
idris.note: Right-activation of the NOT nodes by a newly asserted fact retracts every activation it blocks, before the next selection.

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__acquire_after_history
idris.note: Theorem 6, closed at the top: after any history every live fact is rejected by every activation's NOT nodes that admit it.

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__live_rejected
idris.note: Under the view every NOT node's block counts are exact, so no live fact a NOT node admits joins an activation's prefix.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate_ordered
idris.note: The tokens a NOT node newly blocks end downstream; the terminal loses them and gains nothing out of place.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate_consistent
idris.note: A FACT ENTERS ONE ALPHA MEMORY: every chain consistent with the old memories is, after right-activating its nodes fed by that alpha deepest first, consistent with the new ones. A positive node's extensions by the fact reach the terminal through the nodes below; a NOT node's newly blocked tokens are withdrawn from them. The clause's right-activation, and [IRET.19.1] step 7 read as right- rather than left-activation: the step feeds an alpha memory, which is a join's right input.

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__block_ok
idris.note: Counting a new fact against the tokens it joins gives the blockers of the grown memory.

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__newly_sub
idris.note: The tokens a new fact newly blocks were passed.

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__pass_block
idris.note: A NOT node's output after a new right fact: what it passed, less the tokens the fact newly blocks.

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__pass_block_bwd
idris.note: What was passed and is not newly blocked is still passed.

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__pass_block_fwd
idris.note: What a NOT node passes after a new right fact was passed before and is not newly blocked.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate_evolves
idris.note: A NOT node's right-activation withdraws only matches the fact now blocks: matches holding it, read as the blocker.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate_pairs
idris.note: The pairs a right-activation evaluates, deepest node first as `iret_7_7__right_activate` runs it: the new fact against every left token of every node on its alpha, then the extensions' wave down the deeper nodes. Deepest-first is what produces each positive match once, and what evaluates, at a positive node, tokens a shallower `no` node on the same fact is about to block (`lerr_1_4_12__transient_pair_records_nothing`).

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__block_hit
idris.note: Blocking adds one to the count of each token hit, given the hits are distinct.

idris.name: iret_7_9_2__block_miss
idris.note: Blocking leaves the count of a token not among those hit.
